summary: Credentials are sealed at rest: every secret written to the store encrypts under a per-master-key AEAD (ChaCha20-Poly1305, fresh random nonce per secret, versioned hex blobs). The master key loads from ANVIL_SECRET_KEY or is generated once as a 0600 file beside the store; reopening the database with a different key fails explicitly rather than serving garbage. Rows written before encryption read back unchanged, commission signal tokens remain hash-only, and auth add / github onboarding are unchanged — encryption is transparent to every client.
